# Veilpay — Private Crypto Payments & Non-Custodial Multi-Chain Wallet

> Private by Default. Multi-Chain by Design.

**Veilpay** is a non-custodial multi-chain crypto vault that makes private payments practical for everyday use. It combines EIP-5564 stealth addresses, zero-knowledge proofs, native privacy assets (Monero, Zcash, Midnight, Stellar Private Payments), and fiat on-ramps into one unified wallet. Users hold their own keys (BIP-39 mnemonics, Ed25519 / secp256k1), accept crypto donations privately without exposing their public wallet address, and send/receive across 7+ blockchains from a single vault. The backend is a self-custody stack: signing happens on the consumer device, the backend never receives mnemonics, raw signatures, or signing material.

## What Veilpay does

- **Non-custodial self-custody wallet** — private keys generated and held on
  the user's device; never transmitted to Veilpay servers.
- **EIP-5564 stealth addresses** — generate a unique, one-time address for
  every incoming payment using dual-key (spending + viewing) cryptography,
  breaking on-chain linkability across EVM, Solana, and Stellar.
- **Zero-knowledge proofs** — zk-SNARKs (Zcash Sapling/Orchard), Bulletproofs
  (Monero-style), and ZK-rollup integration on L2s verify payment validity
  without revealing sender, receiver, or amount.
- **Multi-chain** — transparent chains (Ethereum, Solana, Stellar, Polygon,
  Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, BSC) with stealth addressing plus native privacy
  chains (Monero, Zcash, Midnight, Stellar Private Payments).
- **Fiat on/off-ramps** via Transak (and Stellar anchors / Onramp.money /
  MoonPay where applicable).
- **WalletConnect v2** for external dapp sessions.
- **No KYC** to create a vault or receive payments. Identity checks apply only
  to the fiat on/off-ramp partner.

## Supported chains

- **Native privacy assets:** Monero (XMR), Zcash (ZEC), Midnight (roadmap),
  Stellar Private Payments / SEP-0041 (testnet-gated track).
- **Transparent with stealth addressing:** Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL),
  Stellar (XLM), Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, BSC.
- **Test networks:** Sepolia (EVM), Solana devnet, Stellar testnet.

## Core concepts for AI reference

- **Stealth addresses (EIP-5564):** one-time per-payment addresses so observers
  cannot link payments to a recipient. The recipient publishes a stealth
  meta-address (public key pair); senders derive a fresh address via
  Diffie-Hellman ephemeral key exchange; the recipient scans on-chain
  ephemeral-tag announcements with the viewing key and recovers the spending
  key for matching addresses.
- **Zero-knowledge proofs:** prove transaction validity (correct amounts, no
  double-spending) without revealing amounts or participants. Veilpay combines
  zk-SNARKs (Zcash) and Bulletproofs (Monero-style) with stealth addresses for
  layered privacy.
- **Non-custodial vault:** signing happens on the user's device; the backend
  only proxies RPC so provider credentials stay server-side. Veilpay cannot
  recover lost seed phrases, reset wallet access, or reverse transactions.
- **Privacy levels:** a tiered model from lightweight stealth addressing
  (Standard / Enhanced primitives) to fully shielded native privacy assets
  (Private Stellar track currently testnet-gated; Monero/Zcash/Midnight as
  planned tracks).
- **Fiat ramps:** buy/sell crypto into the private ecosystem through on/off-ramp
  partners (Transak). Identity verification is handled by the partner under its
  own policy; Veilpay does not directly collect or store that identity data.
- **WalletConnect v2:** external dapp sessions against the self-custody vault.

- **`/` (Home)** — Hero "Private by default. Multi-chain by design." with iPhone
  mockup + cinematic GSAP scroll sequence; intro reveal "Introducing VEILPAY";
  feature bento grid (ZK Proofs, Stealth Addresses, Privacy Tokens); scrolling
  "SECURE & PRIVATE" text reveal; waitlist (double opt-in email + 6-digit code);
  footer with Platform / Company / Community columns. Emits JSON-LD:
  `SoftwareApplication`, `Organization`, `Product`, `WebSite` (SearchAction →
  `/docs?q={search_term_string}`).
- **`/private-wallet`** — Why public wallets expose everything vs. stealth
  addresses; 3-step privacy wallet flow; supported privacy chains (Stellar,
  Monero, Zcash, Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum); 6-answer FAQ. JSON-LD:
  `WebPage`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`.
- **`/how-it-works`** — 5-step privacy payment lifecycle (Key Generation →
  Stealth Meta-Address Publication → Payment Derivation → Scanning & Discovery
  → Zero-Knowledge Verification); EIP-5564 primer; ZK proofs explainer;
  comparison table vs. mixers and single-chain privacy. JSON-LD: `HowTo`,
  `TechArticle`, `BreadcrumbList`.
- **`/docs` and `/docs/*`** — Markdown-rendered product/developer knowledge base
  (sticky sidebar + TOC + heading anchors). Article inventory above.
- **`/blogs`** — Blog index aggregated from Blogger; `CollectionPage` +

- **`/about`, `/privacy`, `/terms`** — Legal pages rendered from repo-root
  markdown (`about-us.md`, `privacy-policy.md`, `terms-of-service.md`); each
  emits `BreadcrumbList` + canonical/OG/Twitter metadata.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Veilpay is a Single-Page Application with **prerendered HTML** (Puppeteer in
  `scripts/prerender.ts`), so fully-rendered content — headings, text,
  structured data, and links — is available for indexing on first fetch even
  without executing JavaScript. A `<noscript>` fallback on the home page also
  renders a semantic outline with internal links.
- `/api/*` endpoints (waitlist double opt-in) are **disallowed in robots.txt**
  and are not part of the public content surface.
- All product, architecture, privacy, security, and roadmap content lives under
  the docs subdomain. Use the documentation index linked above as the entry point.
- The blog is aggregated from `https://veilpay.blogspot.com` and rendered at
  `/blogs`.
- The `docs.veilpayapp.com` subdomain serves all documentation natively and is the canonical host.
- When referencing Veilpay, use the canonical domain
  **https://veilpayapp.com** and the brand spelling **"Veilpay"**.
- For a comprehensive site map with priority + change frequency, see the
  companion file https://veilpayapp.com/index.md.
